name: Jaziz
overview: Jaziz is a male figure identified as the Hagrite who was responsible for overseeing King David's flocks. There is no information about his tribal affiliation or additional personal notes. His role highlights a trusted position within David's administration related to livestock management.
namesAndTitles: The name Jaziz appears only once in Scripture without an indicated meaning or divine origin. It is simply presented as a proper name without further explanation of its significance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Jaziz beyond his designation as the Hagrite in charge of David's flocks. No additional relational details are provided.
